Smeargle

Normal

Johto · Generation 2

Smeargle is a Normal-type Painter Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 58 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (75), with a base stat total of 250.
